defs.def: not moving, acting or done quickly; taking a long time; not fast 缓慢的；迟缓的；耗时的；慢的

ex.s: You’ll compete with fewer tourists, save money, experience a different side of a popular place, and boost the economy when tourism is traditionally slower.
ex.t: 你会与更少的游客竞争、省钱、体验热门地点的不同一面，并在传统淡季提振当地经济。

ex.s: Too much workout often slows metabolic rates.
ex.t: 锻炼过多往往会降低新陈代谢率。

ex.s: It involves doing very slow physical exercises to relax your mind and calm your body.
ex.t: 它涉及做非常缓慢的身体练习，以放松你的头脑，平静你的身体。

ex.s: The human mind is bad at noting slow change.
ex.t: 人类大脑不善于察觉缓慢的变化。

ex.s: They tolerate long, slow journeys to and from work on packed highways because they can work, entertain themselves or sleep on the ride, which encourages urban spread.
ex.t: 他们忍受在拥挤的高速公路上漫长而缓慢的上下班通勤，因为他们可以在途中工作、娱乐或睡觉，这促进了城市扩张。

ex.s: They raise the local temperature slowly.
ex.t: 它们使当地气温缓慢上升。

ex.s: It is recently reported that the number of those sticking to a traditional diet is slowly declining and around half of Britain’s consumers would like to change or improve their cooking in some way.
ex.t: 最近有报道称，坚持传统饮食的人数正在缓慢下降，约一半英国消费者想以某种方式改变或改善自己的烹饪。

ex.s: But not all cities develop slowly over a long period of time.
ex.t: 但并非所有城市都在很长一段时间内缓慢发展。

ex.s: “For example, most of us would expect older drivers always go slower than everyone else but surprisingly, we found that in 30mph zones they struggled to keep at a constant speed and so were more likely to break the speed limit and be at risk of getting fined.
ex.t: “例如，我们大多数人都以为老年驾驶者总是比其他人开得慢，但令人惊讶的是，我们发现，在限速30英里每小时的区域，他们难以保持匀速，因此更有可能超速并被罚款的风险。

ex.s: Hence this book, Chasing the Sea: Lost Among the Ghosts of Empire in Central Asia, which talks about a road trip from Tashkent to Karakalpakstan, where millions of lives have been destroyed by the slow drying up of the sea.
ex.t: 于是有了这本书——《追逐大海：在中亚帝国的幽灵中迷失》，它讲述了一段从塔什干到卡拉卡尔帕克斯坦的公路旅行，在那里，数百万人的生活被大海缓慢干涸所摧毁。

ex.s: Impatience with slow service.
ex.t: 不耐烦 服务缓慢。

ex.s: Slowly but surely, my efforts to adjust to the new routine paid off.
ex.t: 我努力适应新作息，缓慢但稳步地见到了成效。

defs.def: not going or allowing you to go at a fast speed 慢速的；低速的

ex.s: Learn from prior experience to slow it down.
ex.t: Taylor迅速的行动帮助队友冷静下来。

defs.def: hesitating to do sth or not doing sth immediately 迟迟不 … ；不乐意；慢吞吞的
not quick to learn; finding things hard to understand 迟钝的；笨的；理解力差的
not very busy; containing little action 不忙碌的；清淡的；冷清的

ex.s: Their business is slow.
ex.t: 他们的生意清淡。

defs.def: showing a time earlier than the correct time 慢

ex.s: Prior to SLEAP, tracking the physical characteristics of both plants and animals required a lot of labor that slowed the scientific process.
ex.t: 在SLEAP出现之前，追踪动植物物理特征需要大量人工，拖慢了科研进程。

ex.s: The sharks are thrown back into the sea where they die slowly and painfully.
ex.t: 鲨鱼被扔回大海，在那里慢慢地痛苦地死去。

ex.s: 38    So, slow down and think what you really want to do at that moment.
ex.t: 38    所以，慢下来，想一想那一刻你真正想做什么。

ex.s: Slowing down can contribute significantly to personal growth.
ex.t: 当一些人拒绝接种疫苗并想搭便车，免疫就会失效，每个人都面临更大的危险。

ex.s: It slows down a running man.
ex.t: 它让奔跑的人慢下来。

ex.s: It stops on the stone floor — and then turns, moving slowly towards a different corner of the cave, where the wind is calmer and the flies more plentiful.
ex.t: 它停在石地上——然后转身，缓缓爬向洞穴的另一个角落，那里风更平静，苍蝇也更多。

ex.s: I thought my pronunciation was the problem, so I explained again more slowly, but he still looked confused.
ex.t: 我以为是我的发音有问题，于是更慢地又解释了一遍，但他还是一脸困惑。

ex.s: I thought my pronunciation was the problem, so I explained again more slowly, but he still looked confused.
ex.t: 我以为是我的发音有问题，于是更慢地又解释了一遍，但他还是一脸困惑。

ex.s: They pretended to walk slowly away from the dog.
ex.t: 他们假装慢慢地从狗身边走开。

ex.s: I joined a pre-presentation dinner with him and that smaller setting allowed me to slowly build up my courage to speak one-on-one with him—an idea that had seemed completely impossible.
ex.t: 我和他一起参加了一个讲座前的晚餐，那种较小的环境让我慢慢积蓄勇气与他一对一交谈——这曾经看似完全不可能。

ex.s: Then, slowly, he began to nod his head.
ex.t: 然后，慢慢地，他开始点头。

ex.s: It fills more slowly, but all the same, it fills.
ex.t: 它注满得更慢，但同样，它会注满。

ex.s: So I approached our uninvited guest slowly and，through the fence，sprayed him in the face.
ex.t: 于是我慢慢接近这位不速之客，隔着栅栏朝它脸上喷了胡椒喷雾。

ex.s: This is how everyone learned to read． We would start off with sentences， then paragraphs， and then stories． It seemed an unending journey， but even as a six﹣year﹣old girl I realized that knowing how to read could open many doors． When mom said， "The C﹣A﹣N﹣D﹣Y is hidden on the top shelf，" I knew where the candy was． My progress in reading raised my curiosity， and I wanted to know everything． I often found myself telling my mom to drive more slowly， so that I could read all of the road signs we passed．
ex.t: 每个人都是这样学会阅读的。我们从句子开始，然后是段落，再然后是故事。这似乎是一段永无止境的旅程，但即使作为一个六岁的女孩，我也意识到学会阅读能打开许多扇门。当妈妈说：“C-A-N-D-Y藏在最上面的架子上”时，我知道糖果在哪里。我在阅读上的进步激发了我的好奇心，我想知道一切。我经常叫妈妈开慢一点，这样我就能读出我们路过的所有路标。

ex.s: So, my dad and I put on our new cowboy hats, got on our horses, and headed slowly towards the mountains.
ex.t: 于是，我和爸爸戴上新的牛仔帽，骑上马，慢慢朝山里走去。

ex.s: Slowly, and with the camera still held to my eye, I turned… and froze.
ex.t: 我慢慢地转过身，相机仍贴在眼前……然后僵住了。

ex.s: Slowly, and with the camera still held to my eye, I turned...and froze.
ex.t: 我慢慢地转过身，相机仍贴在眼前……然后僵住了。

ex.s: While still holding the camera to my eye, I turned slowly...then stopped still.
ex.t: 仍把相机贴在眼前，我缓缓转过身……然后静止不动。

ex.s: The instructor kept repeating the word, “Speed up!” “Slow down!” “Turning left!” I was so much nervous that I could hardly tell which direction was left.
ex.t: 教练不停地重复这个词： “加速！“慢点！ ”“向左转！ “我非常紧张，几乎分不清剩下哪个方向。

ex.s: Atomic time will get ahead of river time if the rivers run slower．
ex.t: 如果河流流速减慢，原子时间将提前到达河流时间。

ex.s: Progress can be slow, and you’ll wonder if it’s all sinking in.
ex.t: 进步可能很慢，你会怀疑这一切是否真的被他们吸收了。

ex.s: Recently，I conceptualized a new approach to timekeeping that's connected to circumstances on our planet，conditions that might change as a result of global warming．We're now building a clock at the Anchorage Museum that reflects the total flow of several major Alaskan rivers，which are sensitive to local and global environmental changes．We've programmed it to match an atomic clock if the waterways continue to flow at their present rate．If the rivers run faster in the future on average，the clock will get ahead of standard time．If they run slower，you'll see the opposite effect．
ex.t: 最近，我构想了一种与地球环境状况相关的新计时方法，而这些状况可能因全球变暖而改变。我们现在正在安克雷奇博物馆建造一座时钟，它反映阿拉斯加几条主要河流的总流量，这些河流对地方和全球的环境变化十分敏感。我们已对它编程：如果水道继续以目前速率流动，它就与原子钟同步；如果未来河流平均流速加快，时钟就会跑在标准时间前面；如果变慢，则会出现相反效果。

ex.s: “But we all have to accept that as we get older our reactions slow down and this often results in people avoiding any potentially challenging driving conditions and losing confidence in their driving skills.
ex.t: “但我们都必须接受，随着年龄增长，我们的反应会变慢，这通常导致人们避开任何可能有挑战的驾驶状况，并对自己的驾驶技术失去信心。”

defs.def: slow film is not very sensitive to light （胶片）曝光慢的

ex.s: They had slow metabolic rates.
ex.t: 他们的代谢率很慢。

ex.s: By painting buildings white, cities may slow down the warming process.
ex.t: 通过将建筑物漆成白色，城市可能会减缓变暖过程。
